assumptions: level 92, softcore trade, medium investment, bossing profile (not specified by the user)
dual Imperial Claws: melee Elemental Hit needs a melee weapon; the weapon type was not specified
headline skill part Fire Attack; Elemental Hit never repeats an element, so the report gives the per-element range

power charges 6/6 (Unstable Infusion on hit, Deathmarked's Assassin's Mark on rare/unique); frenzy charges 3/3 from the Mark Mastery (10% on hit vs marked, ~10 hits/s); 30 rage from Rage Support on melee hit; Elusive from Mistwalker (on crit); intimidate from Intimidating Cry (must be cast); flasks counted as up
Fire Exposure from the gloves applies to every hit; only the fire part of Elemental Hit benefits, which is why the fire part is the headline
